name: Himatsingka Seide Ltd
title: Himatsingka Seide Ltd - 514043 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Home textile maker pivoting to yarn, fabric and apparel using existing capacity with no new capex; utilisation weak (sheeting 56%, terry 63%) and Middle East shipment delays persist into Q1 FY27.

utilisation.quote: the utilization levels during the quarter stood at 99%, 56% and 63%, respectively, for spinning, sheeting and Terry Towel division

capex.quote: for the most part, we will be within our maintenance capex budget. I wouldn't want to take on more capex at this point

triggers.label: Sheeting utilisation 56%, terry 63%
triggers.quote: the utilization levels during the quarter stood at 99%, 56% and 63%, respectively

triggers.label: New yarn/fabric/apparel verticals on existing assets
triggers.quote: our infrastructure should be able to deliver around INR4,000-odd crores in top line and approximately INR700 crores to INR800 crores in bottom line in EBITDA

triggers.label: Net debt target ~INR2,000 cr within 12 months
triggers.quote: we would like to bring our net debt down to approximately levels of INR2,000 crores

triggers.label: Pricing pressure acknowledged in home textile
triggers.quote: We feel that there could be some market share pressure or pricing pressure in the textile space as we go along

guidance.quote: medium-term view on margin profile remains between 18% and 22%
